messages.text: How did it go at the doctor yesterday.
good. Dr. Kaufman said everything looks fine. bloodwork was normal. she renewed all my scripts for the year
Good. Did you ask about the dermatology referral.
yes I already have my annual derm appointment in March. I scheduled it through GHC online. Dr. Singh at the Capitol Square office
Good. With your complexion you should not skip those.
I never skip it. Every January physical, every March derm. It's on the calendar
I saw a sale at Woodman's on vitamins. Do you still take yours every day.
yes. I do the magnesium at night now — Dr. Kaufman suggested it for the muscle cramping after long runs. and the multivitamin with breakfast
I take that through March. once it's warm and I'm outside every day I stop. I was low on it two winters ago and it made a difference once I started

it's just omeprazole, mom. it's fine

solo 4 miles done. wet but good

good that you're doing something with it. text me when you're home

omg finally 🙌 you've been running shifts for like two years already

one step closer to your little diner dream 🍳

supervisor then manager then save up and figure out the rest

just checking in — you seemed kind of in your head tonight
